in_sanskrit.name: Apurvaj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है New, Fresh
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Apurvaj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Apurvaj is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words ‘apurva’ which means new, fresh, or unprecedented. This name was used in Hindu mythology to denote the novelty and uniqueness of an event or being. It is a powerful name that signifies the beginning of something new and extraordinary.
